# PathSharer Web — LLM Reference (`llms.txt`)

> This file follows the [llmstxt.org](https://llmstxt.org) convention.
> For the full agent guide, see [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md).

## App Summary

**PathSharer** is a zero-account, real-time co-passenger finder for airport transfers.
Open the app, pick a source and destination, tap "Find Co-passengers", and see nearby travelers going the same way. Send a connect request, chat, and split the cab fare.

- URL: https://pathsharer.com
- Version: v1.0.0 (alpha, released July 2026)
- Contact: heypratik.js@gmail.com

## Tech Stack

React 19 + TypeScript · React Router v7 · Leaflet maps · Socket.IO v4 · Geoapify geocoding · Vanilla CSS · Node.js backend (../backend)

## Source Layout

```
src/
  index.tsx               ← entry point
  App.tsx                 ← root (providers + router + global overlays)
  App.css                 ← ALL CSS (single file)
  api.ts                  ← fetch wrapper + guest auth helpers
  AuthContext.tsx         ← auto-login via POST /auth/web-guest
  SocketContext.tsx       ← Socket.IO + SOCKET_EVENTS enum
  currentSearchStore.ts   ← localStorage store for active search
  notificationService.ts  ← browser notifications + audio
  pages/
    SharerPage.tsx        → route "/"
    CopassengersPage.tsx  → route "/copassengers"
    InboxPage.tsx         → route "/inbox"
    ChatPage.tsx          → route "/chat/:userId"
    About.tsx             → route "/about"
  components/
    AirportReminderOverlay.tsx
```

## Key Facts for AI Agents

- Guest-only: no user sign-up. `POST /api/v1/auth/web-guest` runs automatically on mount.
- JWT stored in `localStorage` under key `pathsharer_token`.
- All styles in one file: `src/App.css`. Do not add CSS modules or Tailwind.
- No Redux. Cross-route state goes in `currentSearchStore.ts` or React context.
- Socket.IO auth: token passed as `{ auth: { token } }` in `io()` options.
- Bottom nav hidden on `/chat/*` routes.
- CopassengersPage auto-refreshes nearby users every 10 seconds.
